preRegistered: macro-core.mjs header + RULES + EVENTS (24 Oct 2026, before any run) + data/strategy-library.json MACRO-*
standard: both halves (signal before / from 2024-01-01): > 0 after 0.8% and 1.2% cost, better than the average liquid stock over the same entry-to-exit sessions, better than the same stock / fund on its other days, > 0 without the 2 best, block t >= 2.5, better than SPY over the same sessions (not for the SPY rule), the rotation also better than the equal weight of its 6 funds -> TRADABLE SMALL; block t >= 4.02 -> PROVEN

events.what: Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act signed (clean-energy and grid money)
Russia invades Ukraine (about 22:00 ET on 23 Feb)
Fed first hike of the cycle (+0.25%)
Manchin-Schumer deal on the Inflation Reduction Act announced (late afternoon ET)
Senate passes the Inflation Reduction Act (Sunday)
Inflation Reduction Act signed into law
OPEC+ cuts output targets by 2 million barrels a day
OPEC+ surprise voluntary cuts of about 1.16 million b/d (Sunday)
Saudi Arabia pledges an extra 1 million b/d cut (Sunday)
Hamas attack on Israel; Israel declares war (Saturday)
Israel-Hamas truce and hostage deal agreed (overnight)
OPEC+ voluntary cuts of about 2.2 million b/d for Q1 2024
OPEC+ extends the 2.2 million b/d voluntary cuts into Q2 (Sunday)
Iran's first direct drone and missile attack on Israel (Saturday)
OPEC+ extends most cuts into 2025 (Sunday)
OPEC+ delays its October output increase by two months
Fed first cut of the cycle (-0.50%)
Iran fires about 180 ballistic missiles at Israel (midday ET)
Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire announced
OPEC+ delays output increases to April 2025
Gaza ceasefire and hostage deal announced
"Liberation Day" tariffs announced after the close
90-day pause on most of the new tariffs (early afternoon ET)
India strikes Pakistan (Operation Sindoor, after the US close of 6 May)
India-Pakistan ceasefire (Saturday)
Israel strikes Iran (the evening of 12 June ET); twelve-day war
Iran-Israel ceasefire announced (evening ET)
Gaza peace plan phase one agreed (evening ET)
OPEC+ pauses its output increases for Q1 2026 (Sunday)
US strikes Venezuela and captures Maduro (Saturday)
US and Israeli strikes on Iran begin the 2026 Iran war (Saturday)
Two-week US-Iran ceasefire announced (in force 8 April)
"The deal with Iran is now complete" (Sunday; Islamabad Memorandum signed 17 June)
Ceasefire declared over; US strikes dozens of Iranian coastal targets
